notes: Company: B2B product analytics platform; customers are product managers + data teams.
Primary objective: replace 3rd-party vector search + chat with integrated Redwood-backed assistant to reduce latency and TCO.
Started with Hosted API to validate model outputs and prompt templates; impressed by quality but cost and burst predictability are concerns.
POC ask: Dedicated pool that can guarantee 25 RPS with tail-latency SLOs and region failover between us-west and eu-west.
Quote from VP Eng on 2026-01-15: 'We need predictable per-tenant budgets and a plan to degrade gracefully if capacity is constrained.'
Model preferences: prefer open LLM variants (Llama2 / Falcon family), want verified quantized profiles. Want 70B variant for core assistant, fallback 13B/7B for heavy loads.
Routing wishes: smart routing by latency & cost tier; prefer canary rollout with traffic shifting and immediate rollback capability.
Security: requires SSO/SAML, customer-managed KMS, audit logs shipped to Splunk, 3-year retention for audit artifacts for enterprise customers.

Pricing sensitivity: mid-high; willing to commit to 12mo reserved if unit economics hit target (~30% reduction vs hosted).
Internal stakeholders: VP Product (decision), VP Eng (technical sign-off), Security Director (legal/compliance gate), Finance (procurement).

poc_summary: Goal: Validate Dedicated deployment w/ canary + automated fallback routing to smaller model variants and alternate region for failover.
Scope: 4-week POC - Week1 infra setup & model onboarding; Week2 canary (5% traffic) + metrics collection; Week3 ramp to 25%/50% depending on perf; Week4 full traffic run + chaos/resilience tests.
Canary plan: start at 5% request routing -> 25% -> 50% -> 100% with 24h observation windows; automated rollback on error rate >1% or p95 latency >800ms.
Fallback routing: primary model = 70B quantized (pinned), fallback sequence = 13B quantized -> 7B cached variant -> cached static response if KV cache hit; each fallback adds circuit-breaker metric.

Region failover: active-active us-west (primary) + eu-west (secondary) for EU customers; on network/region failure, traffic shifts to secondary with data residency safeguards (anonymize PII before cross-region replication).
Rollback procedures: 1-click traffic revert in Console; automated route revert if error thresholds breached; postmortem runbook and rollback verification checklist included in SOW.
Observability: token-level cost and latency dashboards pre-configured; trace hooks for per-request routing decisions; synthetic probes for p50/p95 SLAs.
Success metrics: sustained p50 <250ms, p95 <600ms, error rate <0.5%, monthly per-tenant cost within committed range, successful KMS key rotation test.
Deliverables: POC report with perf/cost tradeoffs, recommended Dedicated sizing, canary traffic policy, fallback policy JSON (stub), final SOW for procurement.
